high_level_description: The image depicts two men shaking hands in front of a backdrop that prominently displays the text "中华人民共和国工业和信息化部" (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China) in both Chinese and English. The backdrop is a solid blue color, which provides a clean and professional setting for the photograph. The man on the left is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a patterned tie. He has glasses and appears to be middle-aged. The man on the right is also dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a light-colored tie.
